observed_bottleneck: Current validator uses only four division-enriched samples; per-sample adjusted edge Jaccard spans about 0.808 to 0.983 and t_true is estimated_number_of_nodes
proposed_change: Freeze one embryo-disjoint multi-fold split and one official-scorer commit as the sole promotion protocol; do not change model parameters in this step
expected_direction: Reduce false promotion and leaderboard overfitting; no direct score gain is claimed
validation_gate: All folds run with identical source and checkpoint hashes; report mean median worst-prefix adjusted edge division node-count and runtime with paired per-sample deltas
risk: More validation compute and the available labeled set may still be small
stop_condition: Stop if split identity leaks test stems if scorer cannot be pinned or if full protocol exceeds the frozen compute budget

observed_bottleneck: Markdown and auxiliary receipt disagree with active detector secondary detection ILP disappearance safe-div and bidirectional values; receipt says candidate_unverified
proposed_change: Emit one canonical resolved configuration plus source checkpoint support-code and output hashes after all dynamic patches; make promotion consume only that receipt
expected_direction: Make later A/B attribution trustworthy; no direct score gain is claimed
validation_gate: Receipt values must equal source assignments and runtime manifest; a deterministic checker must fail on any stale print or missing critical knob
risk: Instrumentation can itself drift or accidentally serialize paths and secrets
stop_condition: Stop if the receipt is incomplete contains secrets or disagrees with the runtime call arguments

observed_bottleneck: Active parent-to-daughter radius is 7.0 um while the four-sample validator has division TP=1 FP=0 FN=4; current sister radius is already 14.0 um
proposed_change: Change only BIOHUB_SAFE_DIV_MAX_UM in a frozen grid such as 7.0 8.0 and 9.0 while holding sister symmetry divergence DeepCenter and caps fixed
expected_direction: Potentially improve division recall and the 0.1-weighted division term without changing detector nodes
validation_gate: Run paired embryo-disjoint folds with the official scorer; require higher micro division Jaccard and non-decreasing total score on mean median and worst prefix plus unchanged topology validity
risk: Looser geometry may create false divisions and interact with DeepCenter or per-frame caps
stop_condition: Stop if division FP rises without compensating TP if any prefix total score regresses beyond the frozen tolerance or if cap saturation increases

observed_bottleneck: At weight 0.80 the retention guard falls back on 64 of 100 frames for 44b6_0b24845f but on at most one frame for each other production movie
proposed_change: Change only BIOHUB_SECONDARY_DETECTION_WEIGHT using a small frozen scalar grid below 0.80; keep detector threshold retention threshold and edge blend fixed
expected_direction: Reduce dataset-specific candidate suppression and fallback churn while preserving useful secondary-seed consensus
validation_gate: Paired folds must report candidate recall proxy node-count penalty fallback fraction adjusted edge and total score by embryo prefix; select before any leaderboard write
risk: Retention is only a count ratio; reducing fallback can still add false nodes and a public-test-specific optimum may not transfer
stop_condition: Stop if node-count penalty or edge FP worsens if gains occur in only one prefix or if retention improves without official-score improvement

observed_bottleneck: Validator decomposition records 56 fragmented and 45 lost-to-detection edges with zero wrong-association edges; production adds 644 single-gap and 270 gap-2 nodes
proposed_change: Change only BIOHUB_GAP_CLOSE_UM around the active 5.8 um using a narrow frozen grid while keeping gap length density adaptation and caps fixed
expected_direction: Potentially recover short missing detections and reduce fragmentation
validation_gate: On paired folds require fewer fragmented or lost edges and higher adjusted edge score without increased wrong associations long edges synthetic-node cap use or runtime breach
risk: A larger radius can connect unrelated cells in dense frames; a smaller radius can increase fragmentation
stop_condition: Stop on any topology violation material wrong-association increase dense-prefix regression or no stable total-score gain

observed_bottleneck: Harmonic probability fusion is active at 0.15 but stale text reports 0.20 or 0.30 and no same-protocol ablation is bound to this source hash
proposed_change: Change only BIOHUB_BIDIRECTIONAL_EDGE_WEIGHT in a preregistered grid including 0.0 and the active 0.15; keep fusion mode and all detector settings fixed
expected_direction: Test whether reverse-time agreement reduces edge FP or fragmentation on the current base
validation_gate: Use identical detector candidate files when possible; require paired official-score improvement across folds and prefixes with runtime recorded
risk: Extra reverse inference costs time and harmonic fusion can suppress valid one-direction links
stop_condition: Stop if runtime margin becomes unsafe if any prefix degrades materially or if improvement disappears under fixed candidate nodes

observed_bottleneck: Predicted-to-estimated node ratios across four samples are about 0.727 1.102 0.968 and 1.126 so detection count bias changes direction across samples
proposed_change: Change only BIOHUB_DET_THRESHOLD in a very small global grid around 0.965 as a diagnostic; do not introduce per-test identity rules
expected_direction: Determine whether one global threshold can improve weighted node-count adjustment; promotion is unlikely if prefixes want opposite directions
validation_gate: Require paired official-score and node-count curves per sample and prefix; promote only if one threshold improves aggregate median and worst-prefix metrics
risk: A global threshold may trade under-detection in one embryo for over-detection in another and can overfit four samples
stop_condition: Stop if the optimum direction conflicts across prefixes or if aggregate gain depends on one sample; then retain 0.965 and redesign only with training-derived features
